_readme: 默认配置。程序启动时读取本文件，再把 config/settings.user.json 的差异合并覆盖其上。不要直接修改 settings.user.json 里没有的字段。

protocol._status: frame structure verified on RTX 5080 captures; GIF payload layout unverified
protocol.model_scope: RTX 50 series Vulcan. 5080 = verified source. 5070 = unverified, requires your own capture comparison.
protocol._length_note: VERIFIED: length = total - 5, stored at offset 4. Offset 3 is the frame sequence number, NOT the length. This is a code constant (constants.LENGTH_BIAS), not a config toggle, because it is now a proven fact. What remains unknown for images is the PAYLOAD framing (chunk size), not the frame length rule.

checksum._algorithm_note: CORRECTED BY HARDWARE TEST 2026-11-04. The checksum is a 16-bit sum stored MSB-first (big-endian), NOT little-endian as the CSDN article and the original spec claimed. Proof: step1 sum(0..6)=677=0x02A5 written as 02 A5; device reply sum(0..14)=714=0x02CA written as 02 CA; doc step8 sum(0..33)=2109=0x083D written as 08 3D. Implement as struct.pack('>H').
checksum._range_note: The frame is VARIABLE length: total = length_field + 5, where length_field sits at offset 4. The checksum always covers bytes [0 .. total-3]. The old fixed 36-byte / offsets 34-35 / range 0-33 numbers only describe the special case where the title is 17 bytes long.

protocol._handshake_note: Source: CSDN 'iGame七彩虹Vulcan火神小屏幕通信协议' (CC BY-SA 4.0, based on RTX 5080 capture). CONFIRMED ON THIS MACHINE (RTX 5070, 2026-11-04): device replied 5A9FA9000CE01F0A00050D000001 0002CA. Structural match (header + length + fixed ID E0 1F) but byte offset 13 is 0x01 on the 5070 vs 0x00 in the 5080 sample, so DO NOT match the whole packet byte-for-byte - match structure + checksum.

port_scan._port_note: VERIFIED on 2026-11-04: the Vulcan screen is COM4 (USB VID:PID=1B3F:0123). Proved by occupation - while iGameCenterService runs, opening COM4 fails with PermissionError 13. COM1 is the motherboard 16550 port and is unrelated.

service.name: iGameCenterService
service._name_note: VERIFIED on 2026-11-04: Get-Service found 'iGameCenterService' (DisplayName 'iGameCenter Service', StartType Automatic, Running) with iGameCenter 2.0.0.82 at E:\iGameCenter. The old guess 'iGameCenter.Service' was WRONG - do not reintroduce it.

transport._chunk_size_note: UNVERIFIED. Provisional value; the real GIF packetization must be confirmed by capture.

ack_wait._status: Public sources do not confirm per-packet ACK. Enabling this may stall or abort transfers. Verify by capture first.

media._pixel_format_note: Interface only - the actual on-wire pixel layout is unverified. Conversion lives in media/pixel_format.py behind a single function so it can be swapped after verification.

monitor._status: unverified - read-only. Collects and logs metrics, constructs a frame preview, never writes to the serial port until the frame layout is captured and verified.

dual_screen._status: unverified - only the merged full image may be sent. Partition / partial-refresh commands must remain disabled until captured.
